designationHistory.name: Okefenokee Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Established March 30, 1937, as the Okefenokee Wildlife Refuge by Executive Order 7593, signed by President Franklin D. Roosevelt, as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Okefenokee National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7593, Mar. 30, 1937
Federal Register: Okefenokee NWR notice, Apr. 24, 2001 (established by Executive Order in 1937)

review.note: Year confirmed; EO 7593. Land was bought from the Hebard Lumber Co. in 1936, before the order.
